items.title: Sands interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: Christian Sands has recorded with Christian McBride, Bobby Sanabria and Gregory Porter.

ctx.x: Pianist/composer Christian Sands has recorded with Christian McBride, Bobby Sanabria and Gregory Porter. He leads his own trio and records his original work on the Mack Avenue label.
Christian was interviewed in Clinton, New York on February 2, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
